    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. The cache is positional: agent() calls replay from cache up to the first call that failed, no longer matches the earlier run (edited, added, removed or reordered) or never started in it; that call and every call after it run again, even when their own (prompt, opts) are unchanged. A call a usage limit refused, or one still running when the run stopped, usually runs again without ending reuse: finished calls after it still come from cache. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

LB_BIL_INVOICE 두 샘플이 모두 100점이 됐어요. S4 SmartForm 샘플 평균도 82.71에서 92.82로 올랐어요. 독립 검증은 한 번 FAIL이 나서 고쳤고, 다시 받아 PASS예요. 아직 커밋은 안 했어요.

**점수**

| 폼 | 전 | 후 |
|---|---|---|
| LB_BIL_INVOICE.zz | 63.46 | 100 |
| LB_BIL_INVOICE.zz1item | 55.67 | 100 |
| S4 샘플 8개 평균 | 82.71 | 92.82 |

나머지 6개 폼 점수는 그대로예요.

**고친 규칙 (모두 SAP가 출력한 PDF와 맞춰 확인)**
- **셀 건너뛰기 (T_CELLNR):** "새 셀 + 셀 번호 n"은 n칸을 건너뛰는 거였어요. 그래서 "Price Unit"이 140mm에, "Value"가 8번 셀에 찍혀요. 기존 테스트가 잘못된 해석을 담고 있어서 고쳤어요.
- **수량 소수 자리:** EA·PC·ST 단위는 0인 소수 자리를 지워요. 그래서 "1.000"이 "1"로 찍혀요.
- **금액 출력 길이:** 금액·수량을 DDIC 출력 길이에 맞춰 오른쪽 정렬해요. 예를 들어 CURR 15,2는 21자리예요.
- **채워지지 않은 숫자:** 아무도 값을 넣지 않은 숫자 필드는 초기값 "0.00"으로 찍어요. 대상은 GS_HD_KOMK-FKWRT예요. 타입은 GetStructure KOMK로 확인했고, 샘플 DDIC 파일에 추가했어요. 원본은 `.bak-2026-11-23`으로 남겨 두었어요.
- **빈 테이블:** 값에 없는 테이블의 루프는 0줄로 그려요. 전에는 견본 1줄을 그려서 이상한 텍스트가 찍혔어요.

**검증**
- 검증 에이전트가 처음에 P1을 찾았어요. 조건이 거짓인 노드도 셀을 옮겨서, 가격 조건 테이블의 금액이 9번 셀 밖으로 밀렸어요. 이번 샘플은 그 테이블에 행이 없어서 점수에는 안 드러났어요.
- 조건이 거짓인 노드는 셀을 옮기지 않게 고쳤어요. 테스트도 추가했어요.
- CI 게이트 통과: keyring OK, tsc 오류 없음, 테스트 1886개 통과.
- ECC 코퍼스 180개 중 T_CELLNR을 쓰는 폼은 ZMMOC0510 하나예요. 고치기 전후 모두 100점이에요. ECC와 Adobe 쪽 실행은 바뀐 값 처리 코드를 쓰지 않아요.

**남은 위험**
- 출력 길이만큼 앞에 공백을 붙인 숫자가 좁은 셀에서 두 줄로 넘어갈 수 있어요. 실제로 깨지는 폼은 아직 못 찾았어요.

name: Entire-Checkpoint trailer in every commit
description: When making git commits in sc4sap_project, MUST include `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer to keep entire session tracking intact
type: feedback

---
When creating any `git commit` in `sc4sap_project` (or any repo where `entire` is enabled), the commit message MUST include an `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer in the trailer block (next to / below `Co-Authored-By:`).

**Exception (user, 2026-11-06): `sc4sap_hanta` — no `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer, no `entire` commands.** entire is not set up in that repo (`entire status` → not set up). Commits up to 13afcf7 carry a copied `f4a6992f9f56`; leave them (pushed, shared branch).

**Why:** `entire attach <session-id>` only registers checkpoint metadata in entire's DB and prints "Copy to your commit message to attach: Entire-Checkpoint: <id>". It does NOT automatically amend the commit to add the trailer (because last commit may already be pushed). The trailer is the chain mechanism — without it on a commit, entire's session ↔ commit linkage breaks for that commit and every subsequent one in the chain.

**How to apply:**
- Before authoring a commit, run `entire sessions list` (or `entire status`) and grab the active session's `checkpoint <id>` field.
- Append `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` as a trailer line in the commit message, on its own line in the trailer block.
- Reuse the same checkpoint ID for every commit in the same Claude Code session — `entire attach` only mints a new checkpoint when there's no checkpoint registered for the session yet.
- If the project active branch is shared (NO force-push policy) and a commit was already pushed without the trailer, do NOT try to fix via `entire attach` afterwards — it will `git commit --amend` the last commit silently and rewrite hash, forcing a reset-to-origin to recover.

**Real incident (2026-04-26):** Commit 1f4c5bf (program-to-spec PNG path fix) was authored without the trailer despite user having run `entire attach 21e03650...` earlier in the session. Result: trailer-less commit pushed to active/backup/main, and a follow-up `entire attach` silently amended local 1f4c5bf → f7615b7 forcing a hash divergence that had to be reset (force-push blocked by shared-branch policy). Net effect: that commit is permanently un-tracked by entire on origin.

**Safe pattern when the session has no checkpoint yet (worked 2026-09-30):** commit first (unpushed), then `entire attach <session-id> -f` — it amends only that unpushed commit with the trailer and mints the checkpoint; reuse the ID for later commits/merge. Never attach while HEAD is an already-pushed commit.

Quick template for commits in this project:
```
<type>(<scope>): <subject>

<body>

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Entire-Checkpoint: <fetch via `entire sessions list`>
```

Update 2026-10-20: for a session not captured by hooks, `entire attach <session-id> -f` creates the checkpoint AND amends the last commit with the `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer. Use it only while that commit is unpushed (active is shared: no amend-push). Used for 42245ae.
